title: Recognise implementation-led pathways alongside central architecture
requirements:
- Acknowledge that capabilities often emerge from local implementations and are standardised after proving value
- Recognise iterative, use-case-led platform building as a legitimate pathway
- Distinguish interoperability through exchange from interoperability through shared platforms
- Recognise the need to deliver now while building the target architecture, and the risk that modularity alone does not avoid vertical design
- Describe how local implementations converge into national DPI-H
- Allow strengthening an existing national HMIS platform as shared infrastructure early
- State how far the approach favours reuse, adaptation or new development of standards and systems
- Note hybrid arrangements in which not all capabilities sit centrally or at the edge
